text:
Ava (Content): Quick last-mile check — final blog copy is in the doc: https://docs.internal/launch/blog-final-draft. Can legal + product sign off by 2pm PT? Also need final webinar seat matrix for demo ops.
Sam (Growth): Quick Q — the hero benchmark line says '35% latency improvement'. What dataset/metric is that referencing? We need the source for the claim.
Leo (Product): That's from the perf deck Leo shared yesterday — internal test vs our v1 baseline on 8k tokens. I'll paste the slide after this.
Priya (Design): Also flag: hero image aspect needs final export for the blog (1200x628). Ava, want me to iterate with the cropped variant now or after copy locks?
Ava (Content): Please iterate now, Priya. We might tweak the hero claim wording depending on legal.
Maya (Legal): Saw the draft. Suggest changing absolute claims to conservative phrasing. Instead of "35% latency improvement" use "up to 35% lower latency" and include parenthetical "(based on internal benchmark, 8k tokens)".
Sam (Growth): OK that works. For SEO/meta we should keep the numeric hook but the wording tweak is fine.
Omar (Ops): Webinar seat matrix: we currently have 200 live seats for the main session + 3 demo rooms x 25 seats. Need to confirm if we want a 2nd repeat — that doubles demo ops.
Nora (CM): HubSpot campaign and UTM ready. CTA copy options below — prefer 1 or 2?
Nora (CM): ```
1) Save my spot — Live demo & walkthrough
2) Register for the launch webinar + demo
3) Join the quick demo session (limited seats)
```
Ava (Content): Leaning 1. It's punchy. Also we should map CTAs to two HubSpot flows: attendees and demo requests.
Leo (Product): Product signoff: I can approve the technical claims if Maya is comfortable with the "up to" language and the parenthetical source text.
Maya (Legal): Fine with that. Also remove the sentence that compares to a competitor by name — keep it generic.
Sam (Growth): CTA 1 + UTM snippet below. Nora please confirm param names.
Sam (Growth): ```utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=cta1```
Nora (CM): Confirmed. We'll tag variant=A in HubSpot for CTA1 and send demo leads to the demo flow.
Priya (Design): Hero export queued. I'll push final PNG in 10m to the assets folder.
publish-bot: Preview link generated: https://preview.redwood.com/preview/launch-blog/4365432100 — scheduled publish window: 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z (pending manual trigger).
Ava (Content): Okay last ask — can everyone drop a one-word ack when you're good? Need to lock copy in 20m and hand to publishing.
Leo (Product): LGTM
Maya (Legal): Legal ok
Sam (Growth): thumbs
Priya (Design): Uploaded ✅
Omar (Ops): Demo ops confirmed for 3 rooms, repeat session pending (will confirm by EOD).
Nora (CM): HubSpot flows set, CTA mapped.
Ava (Content): Locking copy and pushing to publish queue. Thanks all! :tada:
